items.exampleEn: At this point, the river diverges into two smaller streams.
items.exampleZh: 河流在這裡分成兩條較小的溪流。

items.exampleEn: The new rule was introduced without detriment to existing staff.
items.exampleZh: 新規定實施時，並未損害現有員工的權益。

items.exampleEn: There is a growing divergence between rich and poor areas.
items.exampleZh: 富裕地區和貧窮地區之間的差距越來越大。

items.exampleEn: After three months without coffee, she had a relapse during exam week.
items.exampleZh: 戒了三個月咖啡之後，她在考試週又故態復萌。

items.exampleEn: The film shows the degrading conditions in old factories.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影呈現了舊時工廠裡不把人當人看的工作環境。

items.exampleEn: Lemon juice is useful for the neutralization of strong fish smells.
items.exampleZh: 檸檬汁很適合用來中和濃重的魚腥味。

items.exampleEn: Too much rain can affect the harvest detrimentally.
items.exampleZh: 雨下太多可能會對收成造成不利的影響。

items.sentenceEn: After a few good weeks, he relapsed into his old habit of staying up late.
items.sentenceZh: 好了幾個星期之後，他又故態復萌，開始熬夜。

items.audioEn: Our opinions diverge on many things, but we always respect each other.
items.audioZh: 我們在很多事情上意見分歧，但我們總是尊重彼此。
items.questionZh: 說話者和對方之間是什麼情況？
options: They work in the same office.

items.sentenceEn: We noticed a clear divergence between his words and his actions.
items.sentenceZh: 我們發現他的言行明顯不一致。

items.sentenceEn: Being shouted at in front of colleagues is degrading.
items.sentenceZh: 在同事面前被吼，是很屈辱的事。

items.stemEn: He worked long hours, to the ____ of his family life.
items.stemZh: 他長時間工作，犧牲了家庭生活。

items.stemEn: The new road will ____ from the old one just after the bridge.
items.stemZh: 新路在過橋之後就會和舊路分開。

items.passageEn: Scientists studying a mountain lake noticed that its water had become more acidic over twenty years. The change was affecting the fish detrimentally, and their numbers were falling. Two research teams proposed different solutions, and the divergence between their plans led to long debates. One team wanted to add a natural mineral for the neutralization of the acid; the other worried that this would only hide the problem. After months of scrutiny, the two teams' views stopped diverging. Both teams agreed to do both: treat the water and reduce pollution from nearby farms.
items.passageZh: 研究一座高山湖泊的科學家發現，湖水在二十年間變得越來越酸。這個變化對魚類造成不利的影響，魚的數量不斷減少。兩組研究團隊提出不同的解決方法，兩個計畫之間的分歧引發了長時間的爭論。一組想加入一種天然礦物來中和酸性；另一組則擔心這樣只會掩蓋問題。經過幾個月的仔細檢視，兩組的看法不再分歧。兩組都同意兩件事都做：處理湖水，同時減少附近農場造成的汙染。

questions.questionZh: 兩組團隊最後決定怎麼做？
options: 只減少附近農場的汙染

items.promptZh: 這個團隊成員的意見常常分歧。
referenceEn: The team members' opinions often diverge.
The opinions of the people on this team often diverge.
rubricZh: diverge 是不及物動詞，表示「（意見）分歧」（例如 opinions often diverge 等）
「團隊成員」可寫，例如 team members、the people on this team 等

items.promptZh: 她覺得每次上廁所都得向主管報告，實在很有辱人格。
referenceEn: She found it degrading to report every bathroom break to her manager.
Having to tell her manager about every bathroom break felt degrading to her.
rubricZh: 「有辱人格」用 degrading（例如 found it degrading、felt degrading 等）
「向主管報告」可寫，例如 report…to her manager、tell her manager about… 等
時態配合內容（例如 found、finds 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：relapse 例句 After a short relapse, the team returned to winning form 用於球隊戰績不自然，也沒示範釋義「故態復萌／病情復發」的任一用法（建議改成回到壞習慣的例句，如 q08 的 relapsed into his old habit 類型）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改為 "After three months without coffee, she had a relapse during exam week."（故態復萌義；與 q08 主詞、情境、句型皆不同）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：crumb 在本課 q12、q13 都出現，u10-l04 又用；與 to the ____ of 語境毫無關聯
執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：acre、crumb 為低級名詞、與動詞空格詞性不同，一眼排除；acre 在 u08-l01、u08-l02、u09-l02、u10-l04 反覆出現
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: acre、crumb 移除；改為 plummet、proliferate（先前課不及物動詞，放得進 will ____ from 但語意不通）與 impede；relapse 只留在 q12

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：After months of scrutiny, the two approaches stopped diverging 生硬（approaches 不會自己「停止分歧」，宜改 the two teams' views stopped diverging／the teams' plans came together）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "the two teams' views stopped diverging"，中譯「兩組的看法不再分歧」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：跟讀 q11 與單字卡同主詞（There is）、同句型，只換情境
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 跟讀改為 "We noticed a clear divergence between his words and his actions."（換主詞與句型）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：diverge 是不及物動詞，表示「（意見）分歧」（例如 opinions often diverge 等）／「團隊成員」可寫，例如 team members、the people on this team 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：degrading 表示「有辱人格的、貶低人的」（例如 it is degrading to…、I find it degrading when… 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（degrading）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u07-l04-q16；目標字沿用 degrading
